studies.title: The dog sledge and the umiak
studies.caption: Thule hunters harness teams of dogs to sledges and build open skin boats large enough for a whole family and a whale hunt.
studies.prompt: Wide low Arctic shore scene about1100CE: Thule travellers loading a light wooden sled with dog team in foreground, an open skin-covered umiak resting on supports on shore behind. Sea ice and low tundra, practical skin clothing, no metal runners or modern kayak gear.
